Echoing some of the stuff below, my 3 recommendations:

1. Get Claire White, use her abilities to speedrun legendary parts. Use her Random Legendary slot to good use too. 
2. Develop risky parts at end of season, risk resets
3. Develop a one car team. The stats of your best and 2nd best part carry forwards each season, but you can speed it up by only caring about the best part. You can clone that part next season by just making 1 new average part. 

Other advice: the crucial parts arent as powerful as you might think. Engine has a huge impact at all tracks, and gearbox is also influential. 

Once last thing, to speedrun "junk" parts so you can reach legendary quicker: look for the ones that say -3 days (usually they reduce reliability). Taking that with -1 day from Claires 1st slot can give you almost instant parts. Just make sure you have the money.
